description: Pinned external posse case t1222 head 41abce87.
intent:
fix(skills): do not require code-change skills from a Review Round Worker

Done when: A Review Round Worker can signal done without invoking `posse-no-comments` or `posse-deslop`; a Change Worker still must invoke them. Tests cover both.

expected.defect: For a workspace Change Task, WorktreePath is the workspace sandbox root rather than a Git repository; `git -C <root> diff ...` therefore fails and this function treats the Task as changed. As a result, unchanged workspace Change Tasks can be considered to require posse-deslop and posse-no-comments, contrary to the new conditional behavior and the test's unchanged-Task contract.
